description:
It all started with a shared curiosity about space and an idea that grew into GASD.XP! We're from the UAE, creating a space mission game where players design spacecraft, manage resources and explore challenges.

Using the Design Thinking Process, our team combines creativity and engineering:
• Aditi–Plans mission objectives, strategies and orbits.
• Gurudharsini–Designs spacecraft systems and manages resources.
• Deeksha–Develops the game, interface and interactive features.
